subject: Phase 100280 - HTTPS transport and provider configuration plumbing (staged diff)
verdict_justification: The core HTTPS transport transition to ureq 3.4.2 and configuration plumbing for embed/rerank providers are implemented cleanly with verified test execution (1316/1316 passing tests) and robust coverage (TOTAL lines 97.88%, functions 98.98%; all 253 reported files >=90%). However, several actionable defects were identified: roadmap isolation leaks referencing 'Phases 029/030' in .env.example, README.md, and hardware.md; missing module responsibility header on modified validate_tests.rs; unredacted HTTP response body snippets in error returns risking secret leakage on 401/403 errors; unconditional 'sidecar unreachable' tagging on static transport errors causing unneeded retries; bare IPv6 literal rejection in HttpEndpoint::parse; and extreme line count saturation (449/450 lines) on clio-config/src/config/mod.rs.

findings.title: Roadmap isolation violation: Phase numbers referenced in .env.example, README.md, and hardware.md
findings.evidence: .env.example:59 ('# NOTE: provider adapters land in Phases 029/030'), README.md:293 ('Phases 029/030'), hardware.md:22 ('Phases 029/030')
findings.requirement_ref: AGENTS.md Hard Rules: 'Roadmap isolation: never reference ./roadmap/, phase numbers, or roadmap files from code or comments.'
findings.recommendation: Replace 'Phases 029/030' in .env.example, README.md, and hardware.md with generic product wording such as 'upcoming provider releases' or 'subsequent releases'.

findings.title: Missing AGENTS.md module header on modified crates/clio-config/src/config/validate_tests.rs
findings.requirement_ref: AGENTS.md File Header: 'Every Rust source file MUST use the following header structure... New/modified Rust files use the exact AGENTS.md header with truthful ownership.'
findings.recommendation: Add the standard module responsibility, ownership, and boundary doc header to crates/clio-config/src/config/validate_tests.rs.

findings.title: Unsanitized HTTP response body snippets in error returns risk secret token leakage in AmError
findings.evidence: crates/clio-index/src/http.rs:211-215 (let snippet = String::from_utf8_lossy(&body[..body.len().min(200)]); ... format!('embed endpoint returned HTTP {code}: {}', snippet.trim()))
findings.recommendation: Scrub potential bearer tokens and secrets from the error response snippet, or omit the response body snippet on HTTP 401 Unauthorized and 403 Forbidden statuses.

findings.title: Unconditional '(sidecar unreachable)' on transport errors misclassifies terminal client errors as retryable
findings.requirement_ref: roadmap/phase-100280-https-transport-config.md Section 10 Expected Failure Modes (TLS verification failure: 'Hard error; never bypassed')
findings.recommendation: Omit '(sidecar unreachable)' on deterministic client errors such as ureq::Error::Tls, BadUri, and Protocol so callers fail fast rather than retrying unrecoverable errors.

findings.title: HttpEndpoint::parse fails on bare bracketed IPv6 literals due to naive colon splitting
findings.recommendation: Check for closing bracket ']' before splitting authority on ':' so IPv6 literals without explicit port default to 80/443 without erroring.

findings.title: crates/clio-config/src/config/mod.rs reaches 449 lines (1 line below 450-line hard limit)
findings.requirement_ref: AGENTS.md Source File Size Constraint: 'Every Rust source file, whether newly created or refactored, MUST remain at or below 450 total lines.'
findings.recommendation: Extract bearer_for or environment overlay mapping into a dedicated submodule to restore adequate headroom.

findings.title: Stale unwired placeholders EMBED_API_BASE and RERANK_API_BASE retained in .env.example
findings.recommendation: Remove EMBED_API_BASE and RERANK_API_BASE or replace with commented EMBED_URL and RERANK_URL placeholders matching apply_process_env.

issues.title: Roadmap isolation violation: Phase numbers referenced in .env.example, README.md, and hardware.md
issues.why_it_matters: AGENTS.md strictly prohibits referencing roadmap files or phase numbers in code, comments, or repository artifacts to ensure modular decoupling from the planning roadmap.
issues.impact: Leaks internal phase numbers to external repo documentation and config comments.
issues.proposed_fix: Replace 'Phases 029/030' with 'upcoming releases' in .env.example, README.md, and hardware.md.

issues.title: Unsanitized HTTP response body snippets in error returns risk secret token leakage in AmError
issues.why_it_matters: External HTTPS endpoints (OpenAI, Cohere, reverse proxies) often echo invalid client credentials in 401/403 error payloads. Embedding the raw body snippet in AmError violates NFR-6.
issues.impact: Exposed API keys may leak into telemetry, log files, or MCP tool errors.
issues.evidence: crates/clio-index/src/http.rs:211-215 formats body[..200] directly into the returned error message.
issues.proposed_fix: Mask credentials in error body snippets or omit the response snippet on 401 and 403 status codes.

issues.title: Missing AGENTS.md module header on modified crates/clio-config/src/config/validate_tests.rs
issues.why_it_matters: AGENTS.md requires all new and modified Rust files to have truthful responsibility, ownership, and boundary module doc headers.
issues.impact: Header audit inconsistency across modified crate test files.
issues.evidence: crates/clio-config/src/config/validate_tests.rs lines 1-4 lack the //! # Responsibility module doc block.
issues.proposed_fix: Add the standard AGENTS.md module doc header to crates/clio-config/src/config/validate_tests.rs.

issues.title: Unconditional '(sidecar unreachable)' on transport errors misclassifies terminal client errors as retryable
issues.why_it_matters: Errors such as ureq::Error::Tls (certificate verification failure) and BadUri are fatal client errors, not transient network drops.
issues.impact: Retrying permanent failures wastes client time and delays fail-closed error propagation.
issues.proposed_fix: Exclude '(sidecar unreachable)' on ureq::Error::Tls, BadUri, and Protocol variants.

issues.title: HttpEndpoint::parse fails on bare bracketed IPv6 literals due to naive colon splitting
issues.why_it_matters: Standard IPv6 addresses like [::1] contain multiple colons. Without an explicit port, rsplit_once(':') mistakenly interprets '1]' as the port number.
issues.impact: Localhost IPv6 endpoints like http://[::1]/embed fail to parse with 'invalid port 1]'.
issues.evidence: crates/clio-index/src/http.rs:68-77 splits authority with rsplit_once(':') without checking bracket boundaries.
issues.proposed_fix: Handle IPv6 bracketed hosts before splitting on port colons.

issues.title: crates/clio-config/src/config/mod.rs reaches 449 lines (1 line below 450-line hard limit)
issues.why_it_matters: The file is within 1 line of failing the 450-line gate. Any subsequent touch will likely violate the constraint.
issues.impact: Impedes future maintainability and creates high risk of gate failures during remediation.
issues.proposed_fix: Extract bearer_for or environment overlay mapping into a dedicated submodule (e.g. env.rs or bearer.rs).

issues.title: Stale unwired placeholders EMBED_API_BASE and RERANK_API_BASE retained in .env.example
issues.why_it_matters: apply_process_env wires EMBED_URL and RERANK_URL, not EMBED_API_BASE or RERANK_API_BASE.
issues.impact: Operators copying from .env.example may set unwired variables expecting them to work.
issues.proposed_fix: Remove or update legacy placeholders to # EMBED_URL= and # RERANK_URL=.
